bullets.text: Built a browser-only project finder on the Freelancer.com API (vanilla JS, no backend) that scores live projects against the user's profile, ranks competing bidders, and shows Freelancer's fee before bidding.
Analyzes recently awarded projects in the same skills (winning price, how fast the winner bid, winning proposals) and turns them into a ready-to-paste AI prompt for drafting proposals.
Auto-syncs the user's bids into a tracker (replies, offers, wins) and raises configurable hot-project alerts with Web Audio sounds and desktop notifications.
Independently built a construction job management platform (React, Node.js/Express, PostgreSQL) that replaced a client's JobTread subscription, from requirements meetings through deployment.
Delivered budgeting and KPI dashboards, e-signature workflows, PDF generation for invoices, proposals, and contracts, and a token-based customer portal for viewing, approving, and paying documents.
Secured it with Microsoft SSO (Azure AD ID tokens validated against JWKS, restricted to approved tenants) and AES encryption at rest for sensitive data.
Integrated the QuickBooks API with a payment webhook that marks invoices paid automatically; migrated all legacy data into PostgreSQL.
Run it on a Linux VPS: Caddy reverse proxy with automatic TLS, systemd service, firewall rules, and automated daily PostgreSQL backups with 14-day rotation.
Cloud AI interviewer (LLM + STT + TTS) built with Streamlit and OpenAI; delegates compute to cloud for low-spec deployment.
Modular service layer (llm_service, stt_service, tts_service) with pluggable provider architecture and one-command cross-platform startup scripts.
